in_hebrew.name: חנזלין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'חנזל' (hachanazel) meaning 'to be gracious', 'to show favor', or 'to bestow kindness'. This name signifies that God is the source of all grace and kindness.

in_greek.name: Ἁνζέλινος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek root 'χάζομαι' (chazomai) meaning 'to be gracious', 'to show favor', or 'to bestow kindness'. This name signifies that the bearer is a gracious and kind individual.

in_latin.name: Hanzelinus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin root 'gratia' meaning 'grace', 'favor', or 'kindness'. This name signifies that the bearer is a gracious and kind individual.
